title: Plan, apply and destroy with CLI options
scenario:
Your organization runs the `storefront` web tier from the configuration in `/home/coder/lab`: web instances in a default VPC subnet (AMI from the `aws_ami` data source), the security group `storefront-web`, the artifacts bucket `storefront-artifacts`, a `random_integer` build number, and a debug instance with its own security group `storefront-debug`. The configuration was initialized and applied with the default variable values (`environment = "dev"`). The production values are in `prod.tfvars`.

Since the last apply, a teammate has changed the provider requirements in `main.tf`. The tags of `storefront-artifacts` are managed by the FinOps team's tagging tool, so the configuration ignores tag changes on this bucket.

The `aws` CLI is configured for the account and region `us-east-1`.

tasks.text:
`terraform plan` fails since the teammate's change. Make the workspace work with the new version constraint of the `random` provider.

- Do not change `main.tf`.
- `random_integer.build` must not be replaced.

Hint: read the error message of `terraform plan`. [`terraform init -upgrade`](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/init#upgrade) updates the provider selections in `.terraform.lock.hcl` within the constraints.
tasks.validation: Run `terraform version`. The output should list `provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/random v3.6.3`.

tasks.text:
Deploy production with a saved plan.

- Save the plan with the values from `prod.tfvars` to the file `prod.tfplan` in the lab folder.
- Apply exactly this plan file.

Hint: [`terraform plan -var-file=prod.tfvars -out=prod.tfplan`](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/plan#out-filename), then `terraform apply prod.tfplan`. A saved plan is applied without a confirmation prompt and without `-var-file`.
tasks.validation: Run `aws ec2 describe-instances --filters 'Name=tag:Name,Values=storefront-web-*'`. Both web instances should carry the tag `Environment = prod`.

tasks.text:
The instance `aws_instance.web[1]` is unhealthy. Replace it.

- Do not edit any file.
- No other resource may be replaced or changed.

Hint: [`-replace`](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/plan#replace-address) takes the resource address. Quote it in the shell because of the brackets: `-replace='aws_instance.web[1]'`. Keep using `-var-file=prod.tfvars`, otherwise Terraform also sets the tags back to `dev`.
tasks.validation: Run `terraform state show 'aws_instance.web[1]'`. The instance should have a new ID, and `aws_instance.web[0]` should keep its ID.

tasks.text:
The debugging session is over. Remove `aws_instance.debug` and `aws_security_group.debug`, and finish with a clean workspace.

- Destroy only these two resources with a targeted destroy.
- Then delete both resource blocks from `main.tf`.

Hint: [`terraform destroy -target=...`](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/plan#target-address) accepts the option several times. Pass `-var-file=prod.tfvars` here as well.
tasks.validation: Run `terraform plan -var-file=prod.tfvars`. The output should end with `No changes. Your infrastructure matches the configuration.`

tasks.text:
Make the workspace work again after the teammate's change, then deploy production with a saved plan.

- Do not change the version constraints in `main.tf`.
- `random_integer.build` must not be replaced.
- Save the plan with the values from `prod.tfvars` to the file `prod.tfplan` in the lab folder, and apply exactly this plan file.
tasks.validation: Run `aws ec2 describe-instances --filters 'Name=tag:Name,Values=storefront-web-*'`. Both web instances should carry the tag `Environment = prod`, and `terraform version` should list `hashicorp/random v3.6.3`.

tasks.text:
The instance `aws_instance.web[1]` is unhealthy. Replace it.

- Do not edit any file.
- No other resource may be replaced or changed.
tasks.validation: Run `terraform state show 'aws_instance.web[1]'`. The instance should have a new ID, and `aws_instance.web[0]` should keep its ID.

tasks.text:
The debugging session is over. Destroy `aws_instance.debug` and `aws_security_group.debug`, then remove them from the configuration.

- Destroy only these two resources.
- No other resource may be replaced or changed.
tasks.validation: Run `aws ec2 describe-security-groups --filters Name=group-name,Values=storefront-debug`. The output should list no security group, and `terraform state list` should not include the debug resources.

tasks.text:
Harden the workspace and finish clean.

- Any plan that would destroy `aws_s3_bucket.artifacts` must fail.
- The FinOps team added the tag `CostCenter = cc-2201` to `storefront-artifacts`. Make `terraform output artifacts_tags` show the bucket's current tags without changing any infrastructure. Do not add the tag to the configuration.
- `terraform plan -var-file=prod.tfvars` must report no changes.
tasks.validation: Run `terraform plan -destroy -var-file=prod.tfvars`. It should fail with `Instance cannot be destroyed` for `aws_s3_bucket.artifacts`, and `terraform output artifacts_tags` should include `CostCenter`.

expert.intro: In this level the web tier has three instances, `aws_instance.web["a"]`, `aws_instance.web["b"]` and `aws_instance.web["c"]`, created with `for_each`.

tasks.text:
Make the workspace work again after the teammate's change, then deploy production with a saved plan.

- Do not change the version constraints in `main.tf`.
- `random_integer.build` must not be replaced.
- Save the plan with the values from `prod.tfvars` to the file `prod.tfplan` in the lab folder, and apply exactly this plan file.
tasks.validation: Run `aws ec2 describe-instances --filters 'Name=tag:Name,Values=storefront-web-*'`. All three web instances should carry the tag `Environment = prod`.

tasks.text:
Replace the instance `aws_instance.web["b"]`.

- Do not edit any file.
- No other resource may be replaced or changed.
tasks.validation: Run `terraform state show 'aws_instance.web["b"]'`. The instance should have a new ID, and the other two web instances should keep their IDs.

tasks.text:
Destroy `aws_instance.debug` and `aws_security_group.debug`, then remove them from the configuration.

- Use a targeted destroy. No other resource may be destroyed, replaced or changed.
tasks.validation: Run `aws ec2 describe-security-groups --filters Name=group-name,Values=storefront-debug`. The output should list no security group, and `terraform state list` should not include the debug resources.

tasks.text:
Harden the workspace and finish clean.

- Any plan that would destroy `aws_s3_bucket.artifacts` or one of the web instances must fail.
- Make `terraform output artifacts_tags` show the bucket's current tags, including the FinOps tag `CostCenter`, without changing any infrastructure or the bucket's configuration.
- `terraform plan -var-file=prod.tfvars` must report no changes.
tasks.validation: Run `terraform plan -destroy -var-file=prod.tfvars`. It should fail with `Instance cannot be destroyed` for the bucket and all three web instances, and `terraform plan -var-file=prod.tfvars` should report no changes.
